name: paperlight
description: Paperlight：本地优先的英语阅读与语言积累桌面应用。阅读 PDF/EPUB/TXT/Markdown，收录表达和语义、记笔记，并围绕 Vault 内容开展 grounded 对话。

scripts.app:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --mac dir --universal -c.directories.output=.app-build && node scripts/expose-mac-app.mjs .app-build
scripts.check: npm run build && npm test && node scripts/check-node-files.mjs
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --mac && node scripts/expose-mac-app.mjs
scripts.dist: npm run build && electron-builder --mac && electron-builder --win && electron-builder --linux AppImage --x64 && node scripts/expose-mac-app.mjs

author: spursergmk
